set.body:
Consumer: PLS Neuro live response-model explorer (plsneuro C3 child). Math verified in plsneuro docs/verification/response-explorer-c1.md: reprojection identity vs full OLS refit <= 8.2e-12 relative; closed-form RSS/t-maps <= 7.8e-13.

Scope (fit module, shared): a BasisExpandedFitProduct (partialled Gram G of the basis-expanded task design, kJ x V coefficient matrix, per-voxel partialled response squares, residual df) plus a ContrastReprojection kernel: given shared basis weights w (J) and a condition contrast c (k), form A = W'GW with W = I_k (x) w, Cholesky-solve once (Gale), and stream per-voxel contrast maps, closed-form RSS, SE and t maps. Typed errors for shape mismatch and singular reduced Gram; no p-values.

Out of scope here, follow-up before close or as linked work: retention of G / y'y / per-run cross-products through the SelectedEstimates dataset path, and the real-subject verification leg (plsneuro C3 acceptance).

Acceptance: shared munit suite on JVM and JS proving the reprojected map/SE/t equal an independent direct OLS refit on the collapsed design within 1e-10, plus typed error paths.
set.title: Exact contrast reprojection kernel over basis-expanded fit products
